thought.text: Jetzt sehe ich das Problem! Die Persistenz wird durch `createPersistenceBackend()` erstellt. Aber WorldTick braucht alle Dependencies im Konstruktor. Lass mich suchen WIE WorldTick früher erstellt wurde:

reasoning_content: Now I can see the pattern. The PersistenceManager is created using `createPersistenceBackend()` which picks an auto backend (file, postgres, or redis). The problem is that WorldTick only gets `ws` in its constructor but needs all the dependencies. Let me check how WorldTick was SUPPOSED to get created with proper DI.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 2. WIE WORLDTICK KREIERT WERDEN SOLLTE ===")

# Check how WorldTick is constructed in ServerBootstrap
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '385,420p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts")
print("ServerBootstrap start:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check where dependencies come from
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'import.*Manager\\|new.*System' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/ServerBootstrap.ts | head -20")
print("\nImports:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
